title: The Dragon Entered an Obby

noob.caption: #FFD23F
noob.acting: bright, fast, cheerful cartoon character, impulsive and oblivious, great comic timing

steve.caption: #3FE0D0
steve.acting: calm, low, dry and deadpan; a practical survivor who rarely raises his voice

music.note: Ep2 v7's last cue carried on (same seed, level and rise, 6.46 s in at the cut): the racing heartbeat through the arrival, gone as they hide
the frozen players: a serious low bed
the dragon comes for Steve: tension, the hit on the wall
the ride and the rescue: driving, no buzz; out for the comic beat (That was my plan)
rising under the bank, cut dead by the freeze (the stutter)
the glitch sting; Ep4 carries it on

events.note: Ep2's last frame goes on: through the swirl, a violet-white tunnel (Ep2 ends on a flare as the dragon's head enters)
the obby's sky: a purple portal tears open above the start pad, crackling
Steve and the Noob tumble out of it onto the start pad: the Noob lands on his feet and bounces, delighted; Steve on his back
the dragon blasts out of the same portal right behind them, roaring, smashing three course stages, and climbs; the portal flickers and stays

events.name: noob_boss
events.note: the original take (the creator, 2026-11-26: prefers the old takes of the old lines; the new lines stay)

events.name: steve_hide
events.direction_text: [flat, deadpan, unimpressed] That's a dragon. We hide.
events.note: the original take (the creator, 2026-11-26: prefers the old takes of the old lines; the new lines stay)
they run and duck behind the ledge where four players stand frozen in glitch crystal; the dragon's shadow passes over

events.name: noob_hi
events.note: added line: the frozen players' setup (the creator's notes: they had none) (run 45628706087's acted takes read the direction aloud: recorded solo, no direction)
he taps the crystal: a glassy clink; nobody inside moves; a pixel flickers across the crystal

events.name: noob_frozen
events.note: added line (run 45628706087's acted takes read the direction aloud: recorded solo, no direction)

events.name: steve_here
events.direction_text: [low, quiet, a grim realisation] The glitch is here too.
events.note: added line: Steve clocks that something is wrong with this world (foreshadows the frozen dragon)
a hologram panel flickers up in the sky over the course, TUTORIAL: JUMP ON THE BOSS! with an arrow at the dragon; the Noob looks up at it

events.name: noob_tut
events.note: the original take (the creator, 2026-11-26: prefers the old takes of the old lines; the new lines stay)

events.name: steve_dont
events.note: the original take (the creator, 2026-11-26: prefers the old takes of the old lines; the new lines stay)
the Noob leaps from the ledge's red stage toward the circling dragon
the dragon sweeps through him: he bursts into pieces (the dark cube in the burst)
he pops back on the checkpoint pad by the flag

events.name: noob_cp
events.note: the original take (the creator, 2026-11-26: prefers the old takes of the old lines; the new lines stay)
the dragon wheels round, low, and comes for Steve on the green stage
Steve places a cobblestone wall, 3 by 2, block by block
the dragon hits the wall: the stones burst, its snout is knocked down and it drops low, skimming the course; Steve dives flat on the green stage (hit-stop, shake)

events.name: noob_again
events.note: added line: the Noob jumps blind from the checkpoint pad, at where the dragon was
the dragon, knocked low by the wall, passes right under him: he lands on its back (the wall caused it)
dazed, the dragon swerves along the course, the Noob clinging to its neck, and veers straight into the frozen players' ledge
the four crystals shatter one after another; the players tumble out, stand up, look round
they wave at Steve and the Noob, and run off along the course to the next stage

events.name: noob_planwall
events.direction_text: [cheerfully honest] Your plan was a wall.

events.note: the dragon banks round over them mid-roar, the Noob on its neck, full wingbeats
mid-flap it stutters (a twitch back, twice) and locks: wings asymmetric, the cobblestone debris hanging in the air round it; the sound freezes with it, then silence
the Noob leans down its neck and waves a hand in front of its eye
Steve turns, head then shoulders, and looks up at it

events.name: steve_lag
events.note: the original take (the creator, 2026-11-26: prefers the old takes of the old lines; the new lines stay)
the frozen dragon flickers into the pink-and-black missing texture and back; REALITY 97 -> 92

movie_note: Movie Episode 3 v2 (the creator's notes, 2026-11-25; story/movie/ep03_shots.md, 'v2'): picks up Ep2 v7's dive; the portal tears open over the obby, they tumble out, the dragon blasts through after them; the frozen players set up; the tutorial a 3D hologram; Steve's wall knocks the dragon low under the Noob's blind jump; the stutter-freeze; energetic new takes; no upbeat music under the dragon; no PLAN timer (Ep2's countdown, the joke it called back, was removed by the creator).
